name: zrndr_draw_clipped_immediate_line_strip
description: zRndr_DrawClippedImmediateLineStrip dispatches each adjacent point pair in a line strip to the active clipped immediate rasterizer.
known_limits: tier S verification remains deferred to the zRndr draw-path source-cluster pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly/decompilation for 0x498c00 validates early return when segmentCount <= 0, then iterating points[0..segmentCount] and dispatching adjacent point pairs with zRndr::g_frameBuffer, clipRect, and color16 through gRndr_pfnImmediateRaster5.

Native smoke zrndr_immediate_line_dispatch_smoke installs a test clipped rasterizer, verifies two segment dispatches for three points, verifies the last segment coordinates and color, and verifies zero segments dispatch nothing.
